title: Second-lining and watching drummers J.D. Chandler and another
summary: As a boy Happy second-lined behind two hard-drinking drummers, including J.D. Chandler, who played in the Pacific brass band.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Everything was in my wrist. Everything was in my wrist. All that muscle. And I used to rule out, I didn't study about nobody running. I picked that up from Old Man and that was drumming too. And I used to second line. Second line when he was playing with that other man. I used to get the right side of him and the steam eyes on him. Him and another fella. Old fella, you heard talk of J.D. Chandler.

And then, him too. Them was two men. Boy, they used to look for all these people. Boy, them drummers would talk with J.D. would be so drunk. Drunk he didn't know what they did. But they could play it out. They played drunk with so. Sometimes they'd go get him out of the way. He'd be drunk. And I just watched them two tell us. Them two men when I was young, I used to second line and watched them play. And I said I always did want to play like them men. And I used to see me walk, I walked in like 3D Chandler. Fly, my cap on the side. And my head up. I wasn't looking at the drum. Because I knew what I was going to do already. I played like that. I don't see the drum at all. I don't see the drum at all. I don't see the drum at all. I don't see nobody else. Just see the playing. Who did D.D. Chandler play with? D.D. Chandler played one brass band. I believe they had a brass band they called the Pacific brass band. You were talking
that band. I have, but I don't know much about it. No, it's been so long. I can't say much

about it. About the Pacific band. But it was a tough band too. But that was way full of my time. Did you ever see D.D. Chandler with a dance band? No. Orchestra? No. No. But that's time I couldn't go around no dancing. I was too young. See, it ain't like now the children this size, they can go in a dance. But they didn't have that going on.
